# GitHub Gist

> > A platform for sharing code snippets, scripts, and technical documentation as individual gists

GitHub Gist is a service for sharing single files, code snippets, or small collections of files. Users create public or secret gists to share configuration scripts, tutorials, and code examples. Each gist has its own Git repository and can be forked, cloned, or embedded.

## Key Topics

- Code snippets and scripts
- Mikrotik RouterOS configuration
- Network configuration and routing
- WiFi troubleshooting (5GHz, DFS channels)
- VPN and WireGuard setup
- Windows Registry modifications
- Software licensing and activation
- Technical documentation
- Configuration files
- Community-shared solutions

- [Исправление ошибки обнаружения WiFi сети 5GHz на роутерах Mikrotik](https://gist.github.com/nskforward/7684e1c3bb4a8fd8e280c39910d7ef8a): Mikrotik RouterOS guide for fixing 5GHz WiFi network detection issues
- [Route youtube traffic via VPN with Mikrotik / Форвард youtube в туннель на mirotik](https://gist.github.com/sgodunov/e30498c23464c3c362151de36dbdfa98): Mikrotik tutorial for routing YouTube traffic through VPN/WireGuard
